prompts.walk:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D animation spritesheet, Nery Mizuki.
Reference image is the canonical character: copper red long hair, amber eyes, two cream ribbon bows, open charcoal zip hoodie with terracotta piping over cream shirt, dark shorts, bare knees, dark socks, orange/brown sneakers with cream soles. Keep that exact character, costume, chibi proportions and detailed clean anime linework.
Create ONE coherent professionally hand-animated WALKING cycle, 16 sequential frames arranged EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows, reading left-to-right top-to-bottom. True transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Sheet 1536x1536 if possible, each equal cell square. Character faces LEFT in strict side profile in ALL frames, stays centered at same x within each cell with fixed camera and fixed body scale. Full body entirely inside each cell with at least 10% margin.
Animation plan: 0 left-foot forward contact, 1 recoil load, 2 down, 3 rear foot toe-off, 4 passing, 5 up, 6 swing extends, 7 just before opposite contact, 8 right-foot forward contact, 9 recoil load, 10 down, 11 rear toe-off, 12 passing, 13 up, 14 swing extends, 15 just before starting contact. Two legs alternate continuously; one sole is on the exact same floor baseline in every frame. Feet move BACKWARD during stance, advance during swing; no sliding, no backwards knees, no extra legs. Arms counter-swing lightly, elbows bend naturally, hair and hoodie trail subtly. Minimal head bob (1-2%), no head/face redesign from frame to frame. Frame15 leads smoothly to frame0, do not duplicate endpoint. This is one continuous gait, not 16 independent poses. Avoid running or jumping, white matte, checkerboard painted into the image, background, crop, annotations.
